purpose: Minimal declarative example showing how scheduled Chat can recompute an Audit-Closed-style admission decision from repository-bound bytes plus arithmetic only. This is not an observed benchmark trial.
required_scope_guards: Repository/blob identity binds content only; it is not an independent external witness against repository rewrite.
This artifact replays only the final deterministic admission arithmetic. It does not recreate candidate generation, data generation, e-value computation or scientific truth.
A real trial would additionally need the public log hash-chain, genesis, candidate commitment, evaluation completeness and per-entry hashes required by acceptance_from_public_log.
